basic_info.description: Experience the charm of Presidio Heights in this top-floor junior one-bedroom residence that combines historic character with modern updates. Featuring 12-foot ceilings and abundant natural light, the home feels airy and inviting.    The thoughtfully designed layout includes gorgeous flooring throughout, a spacious walk-in closet, and a stylish kitchen with stainless steel appliances and butcher block countertops. A washer and dryer are conveniently in-unit, and the bathroom has been freshly updated to match the home's contemporary appeal.    Perfect for first-time buyers or as a pied--terre, this home offers comfort and practicality with low HOA dues of just $350/month. Enjoy the best of city living in one of San Francisco's most desirable neighborhoods, with nearby cafes, boutiques, parks, and easy access to the Presidio and other parts of SF.
